source.name: WFP Ghana food prices via HDX (sourced from FPMA / MoFA SRID / FAO GIEWS)

notes: Seasonal index method: each month's price divided by that year's average for the same series, averaged over 2015-2023. It shows timing, not today's price.
Markets: the 20 WFP markets with long monthly series (2006-2023). 24 other markets have only 2-4 survey rows and are left out.
Prices between markets are compared like for like only: same crop label and unit, average of the last 12 months of data in each market.
MoFA SRID 2025 file covers Techiman only (22 Jun-15 Oct 2025) and has no unit column; values are consistent with GHS per kg.
There is no HDX groundnut series; groundnut prices come only from MoFA SRID 2025 (Techiman).

Outliers excluded: a WFP/HDX observation more than 3x the median of its neighbours (6 observations before and 6 after, same series) is left out of charts and seasonal stats (raw CSV unchanged; each excluded row is listed under 'excluded'). 782 rows excluded, e.g. Ejura cassava 91 kg wholesale Apr-Jun 2023 (GHS 2,034 / 2,034 / 2,025 vs a usual GHS 400-800).
